title: Saudi Defense Minister discusses regional security with NATO chief, European counterparts

title: Crown Prince receives invitation from UAE PM to attend 2026 UN Water Conference

title: AI could pose ‘existential’ threat to humanity, UN rights chief warns

title: ‎TASI: 39 companies reported 9M 2026 financial results last week

title: ‎Saudi banks’ profits up 7.3% in September

title: This App Brutally Shames You by Tracking How Many Hours You’ve Lost to Scrolling

title: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate

title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
